title: check-adr-0087-registration：成员路径不能穿过 interface，`Interface.member` 的收窄无法登记（接 #36987）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding, the seat's analysis of the ADR-0087 refusal on PR #37433 (#36987); the seat asked the owning zone to file it under #36987. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:fleet · Bug · p2 (suggested; triage grades) · reach: any changeset that narrows a member of a published TS `interface` and must name it as `path#Interface.member` · evidence: the refusal the #36987 dev captured on head ac218b24 (os-dev report 7183552545, attempt 1).

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：ADR-0087 登记检查只能沿对象字面量和 class 找成员，不能沿 interface 找。接口成员改了类型，就没法按 `接口.成员` 写登记。
- 谁受益：改公开 TS 接口的开发者和审查者。
- 不做会怎样：接口成员的收窄只能写成文件里唯一的名字，名字不唯一时根本无法登记。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`: `containerBodiesFor` (~:3714, reached via `resolveMemberPath` ~:3790) accepts only object literals and class bodies as containers, so `ui/packages/auth/src/types.ts#AuthClient.updateUser` fails with "no `AuthClient` object literal or class … is declared at the top of the file", though `AuthClient` is an exported `interface`.
- Walk `interface` (and type-literal alias) bodies the same way, with the same zero-or-several-candidates refusal.

## Acceptance

- `path#Interface.member` resolves to the member signature at both revs; a pin for an interface member, and one where the name is ambiguous (still refused).

Blocked-by: none. Order: independent of #36987's ruling.

Reader: area:fleet / domain:devx triage.
Dedupe: open issues for "check-adr-0087-registration interface" return none.
